title: Cloning a single Panel then deleting the clone doesn't make the Editing Mode settings reappear with the single Panel
line: Deleting a panel from its Panel Settings now brings edit mode back to its normal full-size layout, and Manage Desktops and Panels no longer shows up when all panels are on one screen.
explanation: Pressing Delete Panel in a panel's Panel Settings deletes that panel's view while the dialog is still open. ShellCorona disconnects the view before deleting it, so panelBeingConfiguredChanged is never emitted and the edit-mode desktop keeps leaving room for the closed dialog. Separately, the Manage Desktops and Panels button counts the screens that containments are on, but was only recounted when a containment was added or a screen removed: a new or cloned panel is added before it gets its screen, so it counted as a second screen, and nothing recounted when the panel got its screen or was deleted. The change emits panelBeingConfiguredChanged after deleting a view that was being configured, skips containments pending deletion when counting, and recounts when a containment's screen or deleted state changes.

commits.message:
shell: fix edit mode after deleting a panel from its settings

Deleting a panel from its open Panel Settings left edit mode shrunk as
if the dialog were open, and Manage Desktops and Panels stayed. Say that
the dialog closed, and recount screens when a panel moves or is removed.

BUG: 524360

media.caption: Master: a single bottom panel cloned to the top, the clone's Panel Settings open; Manage Desktops and Panels appeared although both panels are on the only screen
With the fix: same state, no Manage Desktops and Panels button
Master, after Delete Panel on the clone: no dialog left, but the edit-mode desktop stays shrunk to the left and the button stays
With the fix, after Delete Panel: edit mode goes back to its normal centred full-size layout, without the button
Master, leaving and re-entering edit mode with the single panel left: Manage Desktops and Panels is still there
With the fix, same steps: the toolbar is back to how it was before cloning

review.text: Both symptoms are fixed at their cause in ShellCorona. A view deleted while being configured never emitted panelBeingConfiguredChanged because it was disconnected first. The Manage Desktops and Panels count was only refreshed on add and screen removal, before a new panel had its screen. Emitting the signal after the delete, skipping destroyed containments and recounting on screenChanged and destroyedChanged are small, idiomatic changes. Undo and the multi-screen case were checked, and shelltest passes.
